title: New York vs London: Which Should You Visit?
description: A data-backed comparison of New York City and London based on Reddit discussions, real costs, weather data, and traveler preferences.

faqs.answer: Both are legendary cities but they offer very different experiences. New York delivers maximum intensity — the skyline, the energy, the food diversity, and the 24/7 culture are unmatched. faqs.question: Is New York more expensive than London?
faqs.answer: New York is generally 20-30% more expensive than London overall. NYC mid-range hotel rooms average $250-400/night in Manhattan vs London's £140-260/night. faqs.answer: This is genuinely one of the most contested food debates in travel. faqs.answer: Absolutely, though unlike Paris-London (Eurostar, 2h15m), NYC-London requires a transatlantic flight. faqs.answer: Both cities are generally safe for tourists with standard precautions. New York has dramatically improved since the early 1990s — Times Square, Central Park, and the major tourist corridors are very safe. faqs.question: What's the best time of year to visit New York vs London?
faqs.answer: New York: September-November (fall foliage, less humid, shoulder prices) and April-May (spring blooms, comfortable temperatures) are the sweet spots.
